# one-dark theme inputs

Source: https://github.com/one-dark/jetbrains-one-dark-theme

Commit: `1bd06dbd827bd78c97b9662c19e5c1fd64469ec9`

License: ISC (`LICENSE`). Exact upstream bytes and hashes are recorded in assets.tsv.

Original author fields are preserved. If absent, use upstream vendor credit: Mark Skelton.

- `one_dark.theme.json`: One Dark (`one-dark-default`); old names: One Dark
- `one_dark_islands.theme.json`: excluded — Islands variant is outside the approved classic variant set.
- `one_dark_vivid.theme.json`: One Dark Vivid (`one-dark-vivid`); old names: One Dark Vivid
- `one_dark_islands_vivid.theme.json`: excluded — Islands variant is outside the approved classic variant set.
